news.title: Government Launches AI-Powered Citizen Service Platform
news.excerpt: The new integrated platform leverages artificial intelligence to provide 247 citizen support, reducing average service time from 15 days to just 3 days.
news.author: Ministry of Electronics

news.title: ₹50,000 Crore Smart City Initiative Approved for 100 Cities
news.excerpt: The cabinet has approved an ambitious smart city transformation program covering 100 tier-2 and tier-3 cities with IoT infrastructure.
news.author: Ministry of Urban Affairs

news.title: Universal Health Coverage Expanded to Rural Districts
news.excerpt: Health ministry announces expansion of Ayushman Bharat coverage to 1,200 additional rural districts, benefiting over 8 crore new families.
news.author: Ministry of Health

news.title: New Education Policy Brings Digital Learning to 50,000 Schools
news.excerpt: Implementation of NEP 2025 gains momentum with smart classroom infrastructure deployment across 50,000 government schools nationwide.
news.author: Ministry of Education

news.title: Drone Technology Transforms Agricultural Monitoring
news.excerpt: Over 25,000 agricultural drones deployed across 15 states for crop monitoring, pest control, and precision farming assistance.
news.author: Ministry of Agriculture

news.title: India Achieves 500 GW Renewable Energy Milestone
news.excerpt: A historic achievement as India crosses the 500 GW installed renewable energy capacity, setting a global benchmark in clean energy transition.
news.author: Ministry of Energy
